game: TEN@ARI Week 5 2025, kickoff 2025-10-05 16:05 ET, ARI -7.5, total 41.5, roof closed

script.base: Closed-roof game with a modest 41.5 total and ARI implied 24.5 / TEN 17.0. Arizona leads by halftime or late, leans on Kyler Murray (17 car / 112 yds in weeks 2-4), Trey Benson and James Conner to run clock, and does not need a shootout. Tennessee, a 7.5-point dog, falls behind and throws more; Tony Pollard's 16.7 carries/game (50/201, 4.02 YPC over weeks 2-4) gets capped, while short targets (Chig Okonkwo 15 tgt / 65 air) rise because LT JC Latham and G Blake Hance are already out.
script.flip1: Tennessee hangs around or leads. Pollard keeps a full early-down load (he already posted 92 and 64 rush yards in two of the last three) and the rush+rec under dies; Arizona has to throw, so Trey McBride (26 tgt) and Marvin Harrison Jr. (216 air yards) become the volume, not a run-clock stack.
script.flip2: Arizona blows it open early (spread is already a 7.5 blowout flag). Cardinals starters' late snaps are at risk, so McBride/Harrison/Conner/Benson yards stall; Tennessee either empties the playbook in catch-up (Okonkwo/Ayomanor garbage yards) or the offense, already -0.19 EPA/db with no blitz and -0.63 vs blitz, just stalls and every TEN skill over dies.

injury_fallout: Pre-game nflverse report only; final inactives ~90 minutes before kickoff are not in the pack, so every Questionable is unresolved. TEN offense loses T JC Latham (Out, hip) and G Blake Hance (Out, shoulder): pressure up, rush efficiency down, more quick throws — helps Okonkwo and Pollard catches, hurts deep yards for Elic Ayomanor (210 air) and Calvin Ridley (194 air). Ridley is Questionable (knee); if he sits or is limited, targets tilt to Ayomanor (18 tgt / 138 yds weeks 2-4), Okonkwo (15/105) and Tyler Lockett (11/46). Tyjae Spears is Questionable (ankle); if he sits, Pollard (already 50 carries in 3 games) and Julius Chestnut (3/26) absorb carries — that is the main kill switch on a Pollard under. Bryce Oliver is Out. ARI defense: DT Darius Robinson Out (pectoral) and DT Bilal Nichols Questionable (neck) soften the interior vs Pollard; CBs Max Melton, Denzel Burke and Will Johnson are all Questionable, so if two or more sit, TEN outside WRs face backups (not charted to a specific receiver). ARI offense: G Evan Brown Doubtful (hamstring) and G Will Hernandez Questionable (knee) should cut rushing efficiency for Conner (already 2.8 YPC, 20/56) and Benson (21/91); WR Greg Dortch Questionable (collarbone, 8 tgt / 49 yds) would leave McBride, Harrison and Michael Wilson (10 tgt / 31 yds) as the pass options. TEN defense: S Mike Brown Out (knee) and S Kevin Winston Jr. Questionable (hamstring) are the deep-shot opening for Harrison (216 air) and McBride (169 air); DE James Lynch is only Questionable. Sources: pack injury report, weeks 2-4 usage splits.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone charting in the pack. Location splits only: ARI is softest in the middle (7.77 YPA on 44 attempts) and sounder outside, especially right (5.65 on 62; left 6.37 on 59). TEN bleeds every passing area (left 7.53 on 47, right 7.5 on 50, middle 7.1 on 29) and is the worse run defense.
matchup.pressure: ARI blitzes only 18%; TEN is bad either way (EPA/db -0.63 vs blitz, -0.19 vs no blitz), and the Latham/Hance absences can create pressure without a blitz, which pushes Ward to quick throws. TEN blitzes 26%; Murray is roughly neutral (-0.01 EPA/db vs blitz, +0.09 vs none), but Brown Doubtful / Hernandez Questionable can still speed up ARI's clock and feed McBride and the RBs.
matchup.bleeds: ARI: middle passing (7.77 YPA) and 12 explosive passes for 173 yards; rush defense is ordinary at 4.11 YPC with 12 runs of 10+. TEN: rush defense at 5.20 YPC and 15 runs of 10+, plus 13 explosive passes for 130 yards and 7.5 YPA to both sides, with Mike Brown out.
matchup.overlap: The clean offensive overlap is Okonkwo's short/middle role (15 targets, 65 air yards, 4.3 air/target) against ARI's middle 7.77 YPA, amplified by a trailing script and a patched TEN line. Ayomanor is the target leader but his 210 air yards attack outside, where ARI is better (right 5.65). The other real overlap — Harrison/McBride deep and intermediate vs TEN's missing safeties and 7.5+ outside YPA — was not carded because their lines sit at or above recent means (Harrison 45.7 yds/game weeks 2-4 vs 55.5; McBride 57.7 vs 56.5 with weeks 3-4 at 43 and 52). Pollard does not attack a run bleed (ARI 4.11 YPC), which is why the under is the side.

Benson rush 69, 14, 42, 35 (weeks 2-4 avg 30.3 under 38.5) in a committee with Conner (20/56, 2.8 YPC, missed time) and Murray (17/112). Wilson 5, 11, 5, 15 vs 8.5. Lockett 0, 9, 37, 0 vs 4.5.

pro_edge.implied_totals: ARI 24.5 = (41.5+7.5)/2, TEN 17.0 = (41.5-7.5)/2, matching the precomputed scan.
pro_edge.script_read: Total 41.5 is not a volume-over environment. Dog spread of 7.5 means TEN should throw more (WR/TE/RB targets up) and ARI should run late, but the same 7.5 is a blowout flag so Cardinals starter snaps can get cut. Murray already owns the efficient rushes (112 yards), so neither Benson nor Conner is a clean lead-back over. Build usage from shares: Pollard is the TEN bellcow on the ground; Okonkwo is the short-area share, not the air-yards share.
pro_edge.best_price: No two-sided price saved on any prop, including chigokonkwo recyds 27.5 and tonypollard rushrecyds 82.5. Anchor no-vig N/A (Pinnacle, then Circa, then BetOnline not in the pack). No power-devig vs overround comparison. No alt-line overround to rescale. Nothing to shop.
pro_edge.lagging: Only the nflverse closing spread/total is saved (ARI -7.5, 41.5). No open, no book-vs-consensus, no prop prices, so no lagging-line flag can be confirmed after the OL outs or the safety outs.
pro_edge.sleepers: Out or Doubtful: ARI DT Darius Robinson (Out), ARI G Evan Brown (Doubtful), TEN T JC Latham (Out), TEN G Blake Hance (Out), TEN S Mike Brown (Out), TEN WR Bryce Oliver (Out). Questionable same-position sleepers whose lines cannot be diffed because no prices were saved: ARI WR Greg Dortch (Wilson/Harrison/McBride), TEN WR Calvin Ridley (Ayomanor/Lockett/Okonkwo), TEN RB Tyjae Spears (Pollard/Chestnut — this one works AGAINST a Pollard under if he sits and the number has not dropped), ARI CBs Melton/Burke/Johnson (TEN WR overs would be the lagging side), TEN S Winston (ARI deep overs). Treated as unconfirmed; rerun at inactives was not possible here.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Okonkwo should beat 27.5 receiving yards because Arizona allows 7.77 YPA in the middle, Latham and Hance are out so Ward should live in the quick game, and a 7.5-point dog with a 17.0 implied total figures to throw short rather than sustain deep shots.
edge_players.must_be_true: Okonkwo plays his normal snap share (about 5 targets/game, 15 in weeks 2-4); Ward has enough plays for checkdowns even with negative EPA; the middle, not Ayomanor's 210 air yards, is where the extra dog volume goes. Ridley playing or sitting does not have to decide it.
edge_players.kills_it: Another week-4 style disappearance (4 yards) in a 17-point team total; Ward locks onto Ayomanor/Ridley downfield; ARI's 18% blitz rate means the quick-game bump is only an OL inference, not a measured pressure spike; a run-heavy close game never creates the targets.

Tagged script-dependent: it does not survive a close or TEN-led game.

data_check.notes: No projection, no sims, no Pinnacle/Circa/BetOnline no-vig in the pack, so step 8 cannot size a rung or clear the 3-point edge gate. model_p values are pack-only estimates (Okonkwo 0.56, Pollard 0.58), not sims, and both are well under the 70% suspicion band. Pollard rush+rec under: weeks 2-4 mean 75.7 and two of last three under 82.5 agree with the lean; season split 2 of 4 is only neutral. Okonkwo over: weeks 2-4 mean 35 agrees, but the latest game is 4, the 66 is a spike, and the stand-in line is his own median — that disagreement is why this is a lean flagged to the human, not a cut and not a strong. Reviewed and not carded: Ridley (Questionable, 27/57/27/30 on a 28.5 line); Ayomanor over (46 vs 41.5, but 210 air yards fight the OL-out quick-game rule and ARI's right side is 5.65 YPA); Harrison under (45.7 vs 55.5, but Mike Brown Out, Winston Questionable, week-4 66, and 7.5 outside YPA make the counter stronger); McBride either way (57.7 vs 56.5, recent 43 and 52 under, matchup says over); Benson rush over (script and TEN's 5.20 YPC say over, but 30.3 yds/game disagrees — drop the lean); Conner under (18.7 recent rush yards, but 5.20 YPC allowed is the loudest bleed in the pack); Wilson and Lockett (boom-bust, lines 8.5 and 4.5); Chestnut (3 carries, Spears only Questionable). No bet placed.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both legs lost. Okonkwo went under because the 66-yard game was the fluke, week 4's 4 yards was the role, Ward's -0.19 EPA/db showed up again in a 17-point team total, and Arizona's 18% blitz rate never forced the quick game the missing tackles were supposed to create — Ayomanor took the air yards instead. Pollard went over because Spears was inactive, he got 18-plus carries before the scoreboard mattered, Robinson's absence turned 4.11 YPC into a 90-yard day like his 92-yard game, and 10 receiving yards on checkdowns pushed 76 to 86. The counter-case is strong enough that both stay leans, not strong, and the card is flagged rather than sized.
slip_story: One dog-trails story only: Tennessee is behind, the patched line forces short throws (Okonkwo recyds over 27.5), and Pollard does not get a clock-killing rushing day (rushrecyds under 82.5). They win together if ARI leads and TEN's offense is a quick-game chase; they lose together if TEN controls the game on the ground. Do not add a total under, a Pollard rush over, or an ARI skill over that needs a shootout. An ARI lead-back over would be a different stack and is not carded because Benson and Conner split carries with Murray. No TDs, no second market on either player, no depth WR. Not a bet: no price, no stake.
